question: Which materials for vessels are enumerated in this response to the goddess?
premises: Vessels made of clay are named
Vessels derived from tortoise are named
Vessels made of bell metal and copper-metal are named
inference: The vessels may be made of clay, tortoise-derived material, bell metal, or copper-metal
plain_english: O goddess, vessels made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell metal, and born of copper-metal.
